title: Wall Street fears Jensen Huang's ouster will slow Nvidia's AI dealmaking; sources: its $500B lending consortium is in flux and at least one lender may exit (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Wall Street fears Jensen Huang's ouster will slow Nvidia's AI dealmaking; sources: its $500B lending consortium is in flux and at least one lender may exit — The ousted Nvidia chief executive was the consummate dealmaker leading the trillion-dollar A.I. build out.
